underlines.text: I told you in the library, you know, that I should never speak to you again

reference.text: “Yes, or I will never see her again.”

underlines.text: People who suffer as I do from nervous complaints

reference.text: Lucas,” she added, in a melancholy tone; “for nobody is on my side, nobody takes part with me; I am cruelly used, nobody feels for my poor nerves.”
